events.title: Tesla 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders
events.imageCredit: Photo: Steve Jurvetson, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
events.description: Tesla’s 2026 Annual Shareholder Meeting is Thursday 3 Dec 2026 at 3:00 p.m. CT (21:00 UTC / 21:00 Dublin). Shareholders as of 13 Oct 2026 can join virtually at virtualshareholdermeeting.com/TSLA2026; limited in-person seats at Giga Texas were drawn from entries that closed 6 Nov. Details: votetesla.com/annual-meeting-details/

events.title: Falcon 9 · CRS-35 to the ISS
events.fallbackLabel: Watch the live broadcast on X
events.imageCredit: Photo: NASA/Kim Shiflett (CRS-25 liftoff), public domain
events.description: Falcon 9 launches Cargo Dragon C211 on NASA's 35th SpaceX resupply mission from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral, carrying more than 6,300 lb of supplies, science and the final pair of ISS Roll-Out Solar Arrays. The booster is on its eighth flight and will land at Landing Zone 40; Dragon docks with the station on Thursday 15 Oct around 11:00 a.m. ET.

events.title: Dragon · CRS-35 docked with the ISS
events.imageCredit: Photo: NASA/Kim Shiflett (CRS-25 liftoff), public domain
events.description: Cargo Dragon C211 on CRS-35 docked autonomously to the ISS Harmony space-facing port at 10:27 a.m. EDT on 15 Oct, about half an hour ahead of the ~11:00 a.m. ET target. NASA covered rendezvous from about 9:15 a.m. ET. Coverage has ended.

events.title: Falcon 9 · USSF-481
events.fallbackLabel: Watch the live broadcast on X
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: Falcon 9 launched the USSF-481 national security mission from SLC-4E at Vandenberg at about 5:02 p.m. PT on 15 Oct. The first stage, on its 28th flight, landed on the Of Course I Still Love You droneship in the Pacific. Coverage has ended.

events.title: Tesla Roadster reveal
events.fallbackLabel: Watch the live broadcast on X
events.imageCredit: 2020 Roadster prototype · Photo: Smnt, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
events.description: Tesla revealed the next-generation Roadster at the SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas. The stream ran from 7:55pm to about 8:26pm Central on 15 Oct (01:55–02:26 Irish time on 16 Oct). Full replay and write-up: superchargeddaily.com/dispatch/roadster-reveal-2026.html

events.title: SpaceX Q3 2026 earnings call
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: SpaceX posted its Q3 2026 results after the US market close on 20 Oct: revenue of $14.58B and net income of $4.40B. Management then held an audio-only webcast at 3:30pm Central Time, also streamed on X @SpaceX. Replay on ir.spacex.com; write-up: superchargeddaily.com/dispatch/spacex-q3-2026-results.html

events.title: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings call
events.imageCredit: Photo: Steve Jurvetson, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
events.description: Tesla posted its Q3 2026 results after the US market close on 21 Oct: revenue of $28.05B, GAAP net income of $787M and free cash flow of $1.53B. Management then held a live Q&A webcast at 4:30pm Central Time. Replay on ir.tesla.com; write-up: superchargeddaily.com/dispatch/tesla-q3-2026-results.html

events.title: Falcon 9 · USSF-432
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: Falcon 9 launched the USSF-432 mission from SLC-4E at Vandenberg at 4:48 p.m. PT on Friday 6 Nov (00:48 UTC 7 Nov). The first stage, on its eighth flight, landed on the Of Course I Still Love You droneship in the Pacific. Coverage has ended.

events.title: Falcon 9 · USSF-627
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: SpaceX is targeting Wednesday 11 Nov for Falcon 9 USSF-627 from SLC-4E at Vandenberg. The four-hour window opens at 6:35 p.m. PT (02:35 UTC 12 Nov); backup is Thursday 12 Nov at 6:21 p.m. PT. The booster is on its seventh flight and will land on Of Course I Still Love You. Webcast starts about 10 minutes before liftoff. Direct X broadcast URL not posted yet.

events.title: Falcon 9 · USSF-317
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: SpaceX is targeting Thursday 12 Nov for Falcon 9 USSF-317 from SLC-4E at Vandenberg. The four-hour window opens at 8:23 p.m. PT (04:23 UTC 13 Nov); backup is Friday 13 Nov at 8:09 p.m. PT. The booster is on its 11th flight and will land on Of Course I Still Love You. Webcast starts about 10 minutes before liftoff. Direct X broadcast URL not posted yet.

events.title: Starship Flight 15
events.imageCredit: Photo: Shujianyang, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
events.description: SpaceX is targeting Starship Flight 15 as soon as Friday 13 Nov from Pad 2 at Starbase, pending regulatory approval. The 75-minute window opens at 4:45 p.m. CT (22:45 UTC). Planned: catch Super Heavy and Ship, deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites, then a more than 22-hour flight before a Ship catch. Webcast starts about 30 minutes before liftoff. Direct X broadcast URL not posted yet. This is a published window, not a confirmed T-0.

events.title: Falcon 9 · Bandwagon-5 rideshare
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: Falcon 9 launched the Bandwagon-5 rideshare with 32 payloads from SLC-40 at Cape Canaveral at 7:04 a.m. ET on Tue 20 Oct, a day late for recovery weather. It carried SpaceX's second Starfall reentry demo. The 19th-flight booster landed on the A Shortfall of Gravitas droneship.
